description:
Train a Neural Network regression model to predict abalone age. 

1. Download the Abalone dataset from 'https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/machine-learning-databases/abalone/abalone.data' and save it to '~/Documents/JASP/abalone.csv'. 
2. The raw file has no headers. Add the following column names as the first row: 'Sex', 'Length', 'Diameter', 'Height', 'Whole_weight', 'Shucked_weight', 'Viscera_weight', 'Shell_weight', 'Rings'.
3. Load the data into JASP.
4. Enable the 'Machine Learning' module (click the '+' icon).
5. Run a 'Neural Network' regression (under Machine Learning > Regression).
   - Target: 'Rings'
   - Predictors: All other 8 variables (Sex, Length, etc.)
   - Data Split: Test set 20% (Training 80%)
   - Training Parameters: Check 'Set seed' and enter '123'.
   - Model Parameters > Architecture: Set Hidden Layers to '2'. Set Layer 1 nodes to '8' and Layer 2 nodes to '4'.
6. Save the project as '~/Documents/JASP/Abalone_NeuralNet.jasp'.
7. Create a text file '~/Documents/JASP/abalone_performance.txt' and write the 'Test MSE' value from the Evaluation Metrics table into it.
